_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds td_combined_dynamic_depth + per-class extreme depths td_combined_dyn_instr_extreme / td_combined_dyn_data_extreme).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Combined L2 dynamic-depth experiment with EXTREME depths. All configs run the combined policy; the balanced depths are the suite-wide max (instr -48, data -32) and thresholds are pinned (instr 0.7 / data 0.5). static_both holds both classes at the suite max always. The dyn_* configs bucket by fe_frac = fe_bound / (fe_bound + mem_bound) over a window: balanced -> both at the suite max; front-end-dominated -> instructions go DEEPER than the suite max (td_combined_dyn_instr_extreme) and data drop to basic; memory-dominated -> data go DEEPER than the suite max (td_combined_dyn_data_extreme) and instructions drop to basic. The suite max is only an average saturation point, so a strongly one-sided phase can justify more protection than it. The sweep varies how deep the dominant class goes in extreme windows (ext_none = same as suite max, i.e. deprioritize-only; ext_mod/deep/deeper = increasingly past it), plus adaptation speed and band width. Compare IPC / ICACHE_MISS / DCACHE_MISS_LD vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched L2. static_both = combined policy, both classes at suite max always (reference). dyn_* = dynamic combined policy; balanced window keeps both at the suite max (-48/-32), one-sided windows deprioritize the non-dominant class to basic and send the dominant class to its extreme depth (which may go past the suite max). Grid over window (10k/100k/1M/cumulative), balanced-band width (narrow .40-.60, medium .33-.66, wide .25-.75), and extreme depth (none=suite max, mod -64/-48, deep -96/-64, deeper -128/-96), plus a few corner combos.

static_both._params: HEADLINE: instructions -48 AND data -32 together (both at their effective depth; non-zero-sum test).

dyn_ext_none._params: Dynamic: 100k, band .33-.66, extreme=suite max (deprioritize-only). Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: 100k, band .33-.66, moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_ext_deep._params: Dynamic: 100k, band .33-.66, deep extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_ext_deeper._params: Dynamic: 100k, band .33-.66, deeper extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_w10k_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: 10k window (fast), moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_w1m_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: 1M window (slow), moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_cumulative_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: cumulative (window 0), moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_band_narrow_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: 100k, narrow band .40-.60, moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_band_wide_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: 100k, wide band .25-.75, moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_w10k_ext_deep._params: Dynamic: 10k window (fast), deep extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_w10k_ext_deeper._params: Dynamic: 10k window (fast), deeper extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_w1m_ext_deep._params: Dynamic: 1M window (slow), deep extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_band_narrow_ext_deep._params: Dynamic: 100k, narrow band, deep extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_band_wide_ext_deeper._params: Dynamic: 100k, wide band, deeper extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

dyn_w10k_band_narrow_ext_mod._params: Dynamic: 10k window + narrow band (most aggressive), moderate extreme. Balanced=suite max (instr -48/data -32).

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
